sql: SELECT d.id AS disputa_id, d.reason AS motivo, d.amount AS monto, d.status AS estado_disputa, c.id AS cargo_id, c.risk_level AS riesgo, c.billing_country AS pais_facturacion, c.ip_country AS pais_ip, c.metadata__order_id AS nro_pedido, e.estado AS estado_envio, e.prueba_entrega AS prueba_entrega, e.fecha_entrega AS fecha_entrega, s.ticket AS reclamo_previo FROM crudo.pagos_disputes d JOIN crudo.pagos_charges c ON d.charge = c.id LEFT JOIN crudo.envios e ON c.metadata__order_id = e.nro_pedido LEFT JOIN crudo.soporte_tickets s ON c.metadata__order_id = s.pedido WHERE d.id = 'du_PNg3eecIE6roFO';
